cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)
if(NOT DEFINED CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES)
  set(CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES 120)
endif()
project(kda_scale LANGUAGES CXX CUDA)
find_package(CUDAToolkit REQUIRED)
find_path(TENSORRT_INCLUDE NvInferRuntime.h PATH_SUFFIXES x86_64-linux-gnu REQUIRED)
find_library(TENSORRT_LIBRARY nvinfer REQUIRED)
add_library(kda_scale SHARED scale_plugin.cu)
target_include_directories(kda_scale PRIVATE "${TENSORRT_INCLUDE}")
target_link_libraries(kda_scale PRIVATE "${TENSORRT_LIBRARY}" CUDA::cudart)
target_compile_features(kda_scale PRIVATE cxx_std_17 cuda_std_17)
target_compile_options(kda_scale PRIVATE $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CUDA>:-lineinfo>)
